info.title: nb
info.description: CLI tool for Azure infrastructure provisioning, Service Bus topology setup, and deployment for the NimBus platform.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Provision NimBus infrastructure, Service Bus topology, and app deployments.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

commands.name: infra
commands.description: Deploy Azure infrastructure using the repository bicep definitions.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Deploy the core and web app infrastructure resources.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

options.name: --solution-id
options.description: Solution identifier used in Azure resource names.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name used in Azure resource names.

options.name: --resource-group
options.description: Azure resource group name.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Repository root. Defaults to the current directory or a parent directory containing deploy/ and src/.

options.name: --location
options.description: Optional location override passed to the bicep templates.

options.name: --resource-name-postfix
options.description: Reserved for compatibility with the legacy pipeline scripts.

options.name: --webapp-version
options.description: Version string stored in the web app settings.

options.name: --storage-provider
options.description: Storage provider for NimBus message persistence: cosmos | sqlserver. Defaults to 'cosmos' for backwards compatibility.

options.name: --sql-mode
options.description: When --storage-provider is sqlserver: 'provision' deploys a new Azure SQL resource; 'external' reads the connection string from NIMBUS_SQL_CONNECTION_STRING.

options.name: --sql-admin-login
options.description: SQL admin login when --sql-mode is 'provision'.

options.name: --sql-server-name
options.description: Override the SQL server name (default: 'sql-{solution-id}-{environment}'). Use this when the default DNS name is held in Azure's global namespace from a recent delete (24-72h cooldown).

options.name: --resolver-plan
options.description: Hosting plan for the resolver Function App: ElasticPremium | FlexConsumption. Defaults to the existing plan when one is deployed, otherwise 'FlexConsumption' (FC1, scale-to-zero Linux). 'ElasticPremium' (EP1, Windows) remains available.

options.name: --management-plan-sku
options.description: SKU for the management App Service Plan hosting the WebApp. Defaults to the existing plan's SKU when one is deployed, otherwise 'B1' for dev/development and 'S1' for other environments.

options.description: Storage provider for NimBus message persistence: cosmos | sqlserver. Controls whether the per-endpoint Cosmos containers are provisioned. Defaults to 'cosmos'.

commands.description: Copies endpoint data (events + messages) from one Cosmos DB to another

options.description: Target Cosmos DB connection string (required)

options.description: Only copy events from this UTC datetime (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00)

options.description: Only copy events up to this UTC datetime (e.g. 2026-03-20T00:00:00)

options.name: --status
options.description: Comma-separated list of statuses to copy (e.g. failed,deferred). Default: all
